questions.text: With regard the division of power between Federation and Provinces the Constitution of Pakistan (1962) was provided with _______________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Single list of subjects. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Under Yahya’s LFO, what option National Assembly had if it couldn’t frame the constitution within 120 days?
questions.explanation: Answer: Dissolved automatically. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: What percentage of total polled votes in East Pakistan was secured by Awami League in 1970 elections?
questions.explanation: Answer: 75%. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: In which constitution of Pakistan, the Ministers were neither members of the Parliament nor answerable to parliament?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1962. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: When was the local government system under the devolution of power plan, 2001, inaugurated?
questions.explanation: Answer: Aug 14,2001. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: When was the 17th amendment bill ratified by the President, after getting passed by both houses of Majlis-e-Shura?
questions.explanation: Answer: Dec 31,2003. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Who was the first leader of opposition in the first National Assembly constituted under the 1962 constitution of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Sardar Bahadur Khan. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: In which year Pakistan become ‘Republic’?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1956. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: When was the 18th Amendment Bill passed by National Assembly?
questions.explanation: Answer: 8 April 2010. Source: CSS 2012 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2012/).

questions.text: The first nationwide Martial Law (October 1958) was imposed by?
questions.explanation: Answer: Iskander Mirza. Source: CSS 2014 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2014/).

questions.text: How many prime ministers does Pakistan had till 1958?
questions.explanation: Answer: Seven. Source: CSS 2014 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2014/).

questions.text: General Elections of 2013 in Pakistan were held on ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: May 11. Source: CSS 2015 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2015/).

questions.text: The politician who served as both Governor General and Prime Minister of Pakistan was ______________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Khawja Nazimuddin. Source: CSS 2015 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2015/).

questions.text: What was the Purpose of 21st Amendment in Pakistan’s constitution?

options.A: The establishment of the military courts
options.C: Created Speedy Trial Court for 3 years.
options.D: Removed the power of President of Pakistan

questions.explanation: Answer: The establishment of the military courts. Source: CSS 2016 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2016/).

questions.text: Which charismatic Bengali leader was PM of Pakistan from Sept 1956 to Oct 1957?
questions.explanation: Answer: Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy. Source: CSS 2016 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2016/).

questions.text: Who was the first Vice President of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Nurul Amin. Source: CSS 2017 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2017/).

questions.text: What was the total number of Basic democrats in 1965 Elections, who were to elect President?
questions.explanation: Answer: 80000. Source: CSS 2017 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2017/).

questions.text: Friday was declared Official holiday in Pakistan on ______.
questions.explanation: Note: Friday was made the weekly holiday by Z.A. Bhutto in 1977 (effective 1 July 1977 per CSS key); reversed to Sunday in 1997. Source: CSS 2017 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2017/).

questions.text: Who was the seventh Prime Minister of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Malik Feroz Khan Noon. Source: CSS 2017 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2017/).

questions.text: Who replaced Khawaja Nazimuddin as Prime Minister of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Muhammad Ali Bogra. Source: CSS 2018 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2018/).

questions.text: Who was the last speaker of National Assembly of United Pakistan (East and West Pakistan 1969)?
questions.explanation: Answer: Abdul Jabbar Khan. Source: CSS 2018 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2018/).

questions.text: Musharraf obtained a vote of confidence from the National and Provincial assemblies (electoral college) on ___________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 01 January, 2004. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: The Policy of One unit was abolished in _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1970. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: Muree Declaration was signed between ______ and _____.
questions.explanation: Answer: PPP and PML-N. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: Third Martial Law in Pakistan ended on _____________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Dec 1985. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: On 14 October 1999, Gen Musharraf took the charge of ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Chief Executive. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: Through which constitutional amendment, FATA was merged with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa?
questions.explanation: Answer: 25th Constitutional Amendment. Source: CSS 2020 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2020/).

questions.text: Which article according to the 18th constitutional amendment, declares “education free and compulsory for all children of the age of 5 to 16 years”?
questions.explanation: Answer: Article 25A. Source: CSS 2020 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2020/).

questions.text: 18th Amendment became part of constitution of Pakistan on ___________.
questions.explanation: Answer: April 19, 2010. Source: CSS 2020 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2020/).

questions.text: Operation Zarb-e-Azb was launched on __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: June 15, 2014. Source: CSS 2020 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2020/).

questions.text: In which year, Zakat and Ushr Ordinance was promulgated, as a result of which Zakat and Ushr Department came into existence?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1980. Source: CSS 2021 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2021/).

questions.text: When did Pakistan witness the imposition of the second Martial Law in its history?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1969. Source: CSS 2021 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2021/).

questions.text: ___ amendment declared Qadianis as non-Muslims?
questions.explanation: Answer: 2ND. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: On which date Nawaz Sharif became First PM?
questions.explanation: Answer: NONE OF THESE. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: The first Martial Law (October 1958) was imposed during the premiership of which Prime Minister?
questions.explanation: Answer: FEROZ KHAN NOON. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: First general election of Pakistan held in?
questions.explanation: Answer: DEC 1970. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: Pakistan's Supreme command of armed forces is vested in whom?
questions.explanation: Answer: President. Source: CSS 2023 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2023/).

questions.text: When was the 1973 constitution of Pakistan promulgated?
questions.explanation: Answer: 14 August. Passed 10 April 1973, authenticated 12 April 1973 and enforced (promulgated) on 14 August 1973. Source: CSS 2023 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2023/).

questions.text: Who introduced the Basic Democracy?
questions.explanation: The Basic Democracy system was introduced by Ayub Khan in 1959. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ayub-khan-era) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who inaugurated the Pakistan Television Lahore Station and when?
questions.explanation: President Ayub Khan inaugurated the Pakistan Television (PTV) Lahore Station on November 26, 1964. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ayub-khan-era).

questions.text: The Basic Democracies ordinance was promulgated in the year:
questions.explanation: The Basic Democracies Ordinance was promulgated in 1959 by President Ayub Khan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ayub-khan-era).

questions.text: 1962 elections in Pakistan were of which type?
questions.explanation: The 1962 elections in Pakistan were Indirect, conducted through an electoral college of Basic Democrats. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ayub-khan-era).

questions.text: President General Ayub Khan ruled for almost _?
questions.explanation: President General Ayub Khan ruled Pakistan for almost 10 years (from October 1958 to March 1969). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ayub-khan-era).

questions.text: On President Ayub Khan was sworn in for a second term as president.
questions.explanation: President Ayub Khan was sworn in for his second term on 23 March 1965. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ayub-khan-era).

questions.text: Who was re-elected as President of Pakistan in 1965 under the Basic Democracies (BD) system?
questions.explanation: Ayub Khan was re-elected as President of Pakistan in 1965 under the Basic Democracies (BD) system, defeating Fatima Jinnah. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ayub-khan-era).

questions.text: The draft of the First Constitution of Pakistan was introduced in the Assembly on and passed by the Assembly on , and assent was given by the Governor General on _?
questions.explanation: The draft of the First Constitution was introduced on 9th January 1956, passed on 29th February 1956, and received the Governor General's assent on 2nd March 1956. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1956) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Parliament has House in 1956 constitution.
questions.explanation: The 1956 Constitution of Pakistan provided for a unicameral legislature, meaning Parliament had only 1 House. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1956) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who abrogated the 1956 Constitution of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: President Iskandar Mirza abrogated the 1956 Constitution of Pakistan on October 7, 1958, by imposing martial law. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1956) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: In the 1956 constitution, what official name was given to Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The 1956 constitution officially named Pakistan as the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1956) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Constitution 1956 provided _ form of government for the country.
questions.explanation: The Constitution of 1956 provided a Parliamentary form of government for Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1956).

questions.text: 1962 constitution of Pakistan lasted for how many years?
questions.explanation: The 1962 Constitution of Pakistan lasted for 7 years, from its promulgation in 1962 until it was abrogated by General Yahya Khan in 1969. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1962) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: How was the representation from East and West Pakistan structured in the Constitution Commission of 1960?

options.A: Five each from East and West Pakistan
options.B: Six from East Pakistan and four from West Pakistan
options.C: Seven from West Pakistan and three from East Pakistan
options.D: Ten members nominated without regional quota

questions.explanation: The Constitution Commission of 1960 comprised five members each from East and West Pakistan, ensuring equal regional representation. Low confidence: commission composition as given in the source. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1962).

questions.text: The Constitution Commission set up by Ayub Khan in 1960 was headed by ?
questions.explanation: The Commission was appointed in February 1960 under Justice Muhammad Shahabuddin; it reported in May 1961. (Source stem said 1962 — corrected.) Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1962).

questions.text: How many articles were there in the 1962 constitution?
questions.explanation: The 1962 Constitution of Pakistan contained 250 Articles. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1962).

questions.text: After abrogation of first constitution, the new constitution was enforced by Ayub Khan on:
questions.explanation: After abrogating the 1956 Constitution, Ayub Khan enforced the new constitution on June 1962. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1962).

questions.text: Who was presented with the report of the Constitution Commission in 1961?
questions.explanation: The report of the Constitution Commission in 1961 was presented to President Ayub Khan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1962).

questions.text: Who advises the President of Pakistan to issue an Ordinance when the Parliament is not in session?
questions.explanation: The President of Pakistan issues an Ordinance on the advice of the Prime Minister when the Parliament is not in session. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: How many seats did the National Assembly have at the time of the 1973 Constitution making?
questions.explanation: At the time of the 1973 Constitution making, the National Assembly had 210 seats. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Article 11 of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973 deals with the?
questions.explanation: Article 11 of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973 deals with Child Labour and Slavery. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973).

questions.text: According to Article 73(1) of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, a money bill shall be originated in _?
questions.explanation: Under Article 73(1) of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, a money bill shall be originated in the National Assembly. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973).

questions.text: NFC Award is between:
questions.explanation: The NFC Award is between the Federation and Provinces of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973).

questions.text: Article 5 of the constitution of Pakistan is about:

options.D: Loyalty to the State is the basic duty of every citizen

questions.explanation: Article 5 of the Constitution of Pakistan declares that loyalty to the State is the basic duty of every citizen. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973).

questions.text: As per Article 3 of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, the _ shall ensure the elimination of all forms of exploitation and the gradual fulfilment of the fundamental principle, from each according to his ability to each according to his work.
questions.explanation: Article 3 of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973 declares that the State shall ensure the elimination of all forms of exploitation and the gradual fulfilment of the principle "from each according to his ability, to each according to his work." Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973).

questions.text: Under Constitution of Pakistan 1973, the Chairman and Deputy Chairman of Senate to take oaths before entering upon their offices in the form set out in the ?
questions.explanation: Under the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, the Chairman and Deputy Chairman of Senate take oaths before entering upon their offices in the form set out in the Third Schedule. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973).

questions.text: What form of government is provided by the 1973 Constitution of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The 1973 Constitution of Pakistan provides a Parliamentary form of government, where the Prime Minister is the head of government and the President is the ceremonial head of state. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/constitution-of-1973).

questions.text: Who famously said, "Democracy is the Best Revenge"?
questions.explanation: The famous quote "Democracy is the Best Revenge" was said by Benazir Bhutto. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/democratic-era-1988-1999) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who introduced the Shariat Bill?
questions.explanation: The Shariat Bill was introduced by Nawaz Sharif during his tenure as Prime Minister of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/democratic-era-1988-1999) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Farooq Laghari dissolved the Benazir Bhutto government on which date?
questions.explanation: President Farooq Laghari dissolved Benazir Bhutto's government on November 5, 1996 under Article 58(2)(b) of the Constitution. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/democratic-era-1988-1999) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: When did former President of Pakistan Rafiq Tarar pass away?
questions.explanation: Former President of Pakistan Rafiq Tarar passed away on 7 March 2022. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/democratic-era-1988-1999).

questions.text: Benazir Bhutto was born on _?
questions.explanation: Benazir Bhutto was born on June 21, 1953 in Karachi, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/democratic-era-1988-1999).

questions.text: What was the duration of Nawaz Sharif's tenure as Prime Minister in his second term?
questions.explanation: Nawaz Sharif's second term as Prime Minister lasted from February 17, 1997 to October 12, 1999, when it was cut short by General Pervez Musharraf's military coup. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/democratic-era-1988-1999).

questions.text: In 1956 the designation of Governor General changed to _?
questions.explanation: In 1956, the designation of Governor General was changed to President under Pakistan's first constitution. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/heads-of-state-governors-general-presidents) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who had the shortest tenure as Governor General of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The shortest tenure as Governor General of Pakistan was held by Iskandar Mirza, who served for only about 7 months before becoming the first President. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/heads-of-state-governors-general-presidents) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who is the Head of the State of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The President is the Head of the State of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/heads-of-state-governors-general-presidents) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: When did Farooq Laghari become president?
questions.explanation: Farooq Laghari became the President of Pakistan on 14 November 1993. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/heads-of-state-governors-general-presidents) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who elects the President of Pakistan?

options.C: National Assembly, Senate, and Provincial Assemblies

questions.explanation: The President of Pakistan is elected by an electoral college comprising the National Assembly, Senate, and Provincial Assemblies. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/heads-of-state-governors-general-presidents) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: After the death of Zia-ul-Haq on 17th August 1988, who was made the President of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: After the death of General Zia-ul-Haq on 17th August 1988, Ghulam Ishaq Khan (then Chairman of the Senate) became the Acting President of Pakistan under the constitutional line of succession. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/heads-of-state-governors-general-presidents) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: In which year was the Federal Shariat Court established in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Federal Shariat Court of Pakistan was established in 1980 during General Zia-ul-Haq's regime. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/judiciary-legal-institutions) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who was the first Hindu woman judge in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The first Hindu woman judge in Pakistan is Suman Kumari Bodani. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/judiciary-legal-institutions) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: As per Article 175-A (VI) of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, for appointment of Judges of Supreme Court, the Commission shall consist of among others, a Senior Advocate of the Supreme Court of Pakistan nominated by the _ for a term of two years.
questions.explanation: As per Article 175-A (VI) of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, the Senior Advocate of the Supreme Court serving on the Judicial Commission is nominated by the Pakistan Bar Council for a term of two years. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/judiciary-legal-institutions).

questions.text: As per Article 186 of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, the President can seek the advice of Supreme Court on any _ which considers of public importance.
questions.explanation: As per Article 186 of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, the President can seek the advisory opinion of the Supreme Court on any question of law which he considers of public importance. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/judiciary-legal-institutions).

questions.text: As per Article 203-C (2) of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, the Federal Shariat Court shall consist of not more than _ Muslim Judges, including the Chief Justice, to be appointed by the President in accordance with Article 175A.
questions.explanation: As per Article 203-C (2) of the Constitution of Pakistan 1973, the Federal Shariat Court shall consist of not more than 8 Muslim Judges, including the Chief Justice. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/judiciary-legal-institutions).

questions.text: Rana Baghwan Das was a _?
questions.explanation: Rana Bhagwan Das served as the Chief Justice of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/judiciary-legal-institutions).

questions.text: Who became the first woman Chief Justice of a Pakistani high court?
questions.explanation: Justice Tahira Safdar became the first woman Chief Justice of a Pakistani high court when she was appointed Chief Justice of the Balochistan High Court in 2018. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/judiciary-legal-institutions).

questions.text: Which areas have been included in FATA by the 19th Constitution Amendment?

options.A: Tribal Areas Adjoining Lakki Marwat and Tank Districts
options.B: Tribal Areas Adjoining Peshawar and Kohat Districts
options.C: Tribal Areas Adjoining Bannu and Dera Ismail Khan Districts
options.D: Tribal Areas Adjoining Mardan and Swabi Districts

questions.explanation: The 19th Constitution Amendment included the Tribal Areas Adjoining Lakki Marwat and Tank Districts into FATA. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/key-amendments).

questions.text: The 18th Amendment Bill was passed by Senate on April 15
questions.explanation: The 18th Amendment Bill was passed by the Senate on April 15, 2010. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/key-amendments).

questions.text: Under which article was the National Assembly of Pakistan dissolved in August 2023?
questions.explanation: The National Assembly of Pakistan was dissolved in August 2023 under Article 58 of the Constitution. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/key-amendments).

questions.text: According to 19th Amendment, the Judicial Commission shall comprise?

options.B: Two senior most judges of Supreme Court

questions.explanation: According to the 19th Amendment, the Judicial Commission comprises the Chief Justice of Pakistan, two senior most judges of the Supreme Court, and the Attorney General for Pakistan, making the answer All of these. Low confidence: composition-option item. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/key-amendments).

questions.text: In his second term, Nawaz Sharif, through the Thirteenth Amendment to the Constitution, the powers of the President?
questions.explanation: In his second term, Nawaz Sharif abolished the powers of the President through the Thirteenth Amendment, which removed the President's authority to dissolve the assembly and dismiss the Prime Minister. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/key-amendments).

questions.text: LFO stands for what?
